body:
commit 818350f (GFD). Fixed 155-item data/items.json casing inconsistency (STR/str, Attack/attack etc.) via normalizeStatKeys at itemdef.Registry load time. Rewrote playerCombatStats to add real equip-derived attribute bonuses (equipStatTotals) and weapon attack bonus (equipAttackBonus) into combat math -- previously gear.Equipment.ComputeStats was purely cosmetic, equipping anything had zero effect on real damage/accuracy. Live-verified: armed vs unarmed damage difference confirmed in a real worm fight.

⚓ ☃
title: S412-01/02: itemdef stat-key normalization + equip stats wired into real combat math
